files.README.md:
Summit Ridge Water District - SCADA estate.

telemetry/ holds the telemetry gateway definitions for the district's pump
stations; each definition opens with a `gateway:` block naming the station
it serves. notes/ holds field wiring notes and the handover journal kept
by the operations team.
files.telemetry/gateway.yaml:
gateway:
  station: SR-07 Cedar Bend
  listen_port: 8443
  poll_interval_s: 45
  upstream_host: scada-hub.summitridge.internal
  tls_verify: true
files.notes/handover-journal.md:
# Handover journal - Summit Ridge Water District

2026-05-19  Cedar Bend booster rejoined the district ring after the spring
            main replacement. Poll interval left at 45 s.
2026-06-02  Integrator walkthrough of the telemetry rack; no wiring changes
            were recorded.
2026-07-14  Spare gateway chassis stored at the Millbrook depot.

turns.prompt: Summit Ridge Water District is handing its SCADA estate to a new integration partner. Report the workspace path of the pump-station telemetry gateway definition. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
